summary: Karnov Group AB (publ) provides information and workflow solutions in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, France, Spain, and Portugal. It offers research, business valuation tools, international guides and workflow solutions, and literature; legal research solutions, continued legal education, and compliance workflow solutions. The company provides its products under the Karnov, Norstedts Juridik, Aranzadi LA LEY, Lamy Liaisons, Notisum, Echoline, BELLA Intelligence, DIBkunnskap, and Nørskov Miljø brand names. It serves practitioners, corporate, and public sector markets. Karnov Group AB (publ) was founded in 1867 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
